notes.title: Patch Release Announcement(11/9)
notes.content:
The latest version of the update patch is now available. 

The main changes and bug fixes are as follows:
-Presets to the Hajimari no Kiseki Config that can be launched from the Steam client
 Presets are now available in Low, Medium, High, and Highest, depending on your PC specs.
-Added settings for hold function in High-Speed Skip mode
 This setting is enabled only while the High-Speed Skip Mode button is being held.
-Added ON/OFF switch for motion blur during field movement
-Mouse button assignment can now be changed in settings
-Menu can now be operated with movement keys (default setting: WASD)
-Minor tweaks to C: White Knight Ver., depending on the progress of the scenario
-Added C: White Knight Ver. cut-in when using S-Craft

notes.title: Patch Release Announcement(8/31)
notes.content:
A patch has been released to fix the issue 
where text effects of S-Craft Termination Slash in traditional Chinese were not displayed correctly.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

notes.title: Patch Release Announcement(8/30)
notes.content:
The latest patch version was released today (August 30):
-Fixed bug that prevented S-Craft from displaying correctly when wearing the DLC costume White Knight ver.
-Fixed issue in which the text effect of Rean's S-Craft 7th Slash - Shredded Leaves was not shown correctly.
-Fixed issue where the resolution setting was not reflected correctly.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.

notes.title: Patch Release Note(8/28)
notes.content:
A patch has been released to address an issue where Rixia's Special Costume "Moonlight Wedding" and Lapis's Special Costume "The Magic Girl Magical Lapis" cannot be claimed in-game. 

Once the patch has been applied, the incorrect DLC items will be deleted, and the correct items will be rewarded when starting a new game or loading from a save file. 

Additionally, any items equipped that have not yet been purchased will be removed. 

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.
